dft.text: Sita Varma sneaks home over the estate wall as the underground racing queen Spitfire, hides her racing suit and changes into the dress her father expects, but Mohar tells her she must be married advantageously and notices aether fumes on her.
She puts on her Spitfire mask and goes to the Aether Rangers' garage, where Pia Nalaar has upgraded her racer with advanced aether systems.

In the race she slows time with an aether canister, shoots through a collapsing platform and emerges on Amonkhet in second place, then later injects aether to slip through raiders and a dinosaur and take the lead.
Racing into Ghirapur at the head of the field, Spitfire crashes into a golden safety wall set by her father's coup and half her mask falls away, revealing her to the guards as Sita.
Sita breaks free and disarms the guards to save Pia, fights alongside Chandra and Pia as Team Avishkar, and her father Mohar ends up in jail for attempting a coup.
